<?php

$stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
$c = 0;

while (($line = fgets($stdin)) !== false) {
    $line = rtrim($line, "\n\r");
    
    if ($c === 0) {
        $c++;
        continue;
    }

    $ans = 0;
    $arr = explode(' ', $line);

    foreach ($arr as $word) {
        $curr = 0;
        $len = strlen($word);
        for ($j = 0; $j < $len; $j++) {
            $charCode = ord($word[$j]);
            if ($charCode >= 65 && $charCode <= 90) {
                $curr++;
            }
        }
        $ans = max($ans, $curr);
    }

    echo $ans . "\n";
    $c++;
}

fclose($stdin);
